title: Find the Velocity Function
text: Velocity is the derivative of position:\n$$v(t) = \frac{ds}{dt} = 3t^2 - 12t + 9$$

title: Set Velocity to Zero
text:
For the particle to be at rest, $v(t) = 0$:
$$3t^2 - 12t + 9 = 0$$
$$t^2 - 4t + 3 = 0$$ (dividing by 3)
$$(t-1)(t-3) = 0$$

title: State the Times
text: The particle is at rest when $t = 1$ second and $t = 3$ seconds.
